papers.title: Microstructures in Heat Treated LPBF Ti-6Al-4V Alloys after α′ phase Decomposition and their Mechanical Properties
papers.abstract: Alloys formed by laser power bed fusion (LPBF) contain high residual stress and strain due to the cyclic heating process, which decreases ductility. Therefore, many researchers have investigated heat treatments to improve ductility by removing residual stress and forming α + β phase structures. However, in this study the ductility of some heat-treated samples was found to decrease below that of as-built samples. This study investigated the heat treatment of LPBF at different temperatures to decompose α′ grains to α grains and understand the resulting microstructure and mechanical properties. Specifically, the influence of microstructural factors on ductility was examined. In the samples heat treated at 500°C, α′ was found to decompose into α with elevated strain and finer β grains, which increased yield strength at the cost of ductility. Meanwhile, in the samples heat treated at 700°C, coarser β phase was precipitated, and greater ductility was supported by the transfer of the slip deformation between α phase grains.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了热处理对LPBF Ti-6Al-4V微观结构和力学性能的影响，直接相关于后处理对疲劳/力学性能的调控。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include fatigue testing or detailed analysis of fatigue life; it focuses on tensile properties and ductility via α′ decomposition.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善LPBF Ti-6Al-4V因残余应力导致的低延展性，通过热处理分解α′相。
summary_zh.method: 在不同温度(500°C和700°C)下对LPBF Ti-6Al-4V进行热处理，分析微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 500°C热处理提高屈服强度但降低延展性；700°C热处理通过粗化β相提高延展性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和微观结构表征验证热处理效果。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the ductility of LPBF Ti-6Al-4V alloys by heat treatment to decompose the α′ martensitic phase and reduce residual stress.
summary_en.method: Heat treatment at 500°C and 700°C was applied to LPBF Ti-6Al-4V samples, and the resulting microstructures and tensile properties were characterized.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment at 500°C increased yield strength but decreased ductility, while treatment at 700°C enhanced ductility via coarser β phase precipitation and slip transfer.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through tensile testing and microstructural analysis using SEM and EBSD.

papers.title: Evolution of the Metallographic Structure of Additively Manufactured Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-6Al-7Nb Titanium Alloys
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to evaluate structural changes and their impact on the functional properties of Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-6Al-7Nb titanium alloys produced by L-PBF. In the as-built condition, these alloys, despite high strength due to the presence of metastable α' martensite, exhibit limited ductility. The samples were subjected to heat treatment at 850-1000 °C for 1 h, followed by aging at 500 °C for 4 h in an argon atmosphere. Analysis revealed a gradual microstructural transformation from the columnar structure characteristic of L-PBF to an equilibrium Widmanstätten microstructure. As a result of the decomposition of martensite and the formation of an α + β phase mixture, changes in microhardness and mechanical properties were observed. After heat treatment, the microhardness decreased by 15% for Ti-6Al-4V (from 427 ± 1 HV to 362 ± 25 HV) and by 12% for Ti-6Al-7Nb (from 408 ± 6 HV to 359 ± 15 HV). The Ti-6Al-7Nb alloy exhibited higher maximum elongation (7.7 ± 1.1%) than Ti-6Al-4V (4.8 ± 0.5%) due to a greater fraction of the β phase. The results highlight the critical role of the controlled α'→α + β transformation in tailoring the properties of titanium alloys and provide a basis for optimizing manufacturing processes for medical and aerospace components.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V合金热处理后的微观结构演变和力学性能，符合L2后处理控制方向。
llm.why_not_core: Does not include fatigue testing, only microhardness and tensile elongation.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估L-PBF制备的钛合金热处理后结构变化对性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对样品进行850-1000°C固溶和500°C时效处理，分析微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: Ti-6Al-4V微硬度降低15%，Ti-6Al-7Nb伸长率更高（7.7%）。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微硬度和拉伸实验验证热处理效果。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effect of post-processing heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of additively manufactured titanium alloys.
summary_en.method: Samples were subjected to solution treatment at 850-1000 °C followed by aging at 500 °C, then characterized by microhardness and tensile tests.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment reduced microhardness by 15% for Ti-6Al-4V, while Ti-6Al-7Nb showed higher elongation (7.7%) due to greater β-phase fraction.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through experimental microhardness measurements and tensile testing.

papers.title: ANALYSIS OF STRENGTH CHARACTERISTICS OF CEMENT-SCREW FIXATION OF MULTI-UNIT ABUTMENTS TO DENTAL IMPLANTS WITH FLAT AND CONICAL TYPE OF CONNECTION IN EXPERIMENT
papers.abstract: Purpose is to analyze the strength characteristics of the cement-screw fixation of multiunit abutments to dental implants with a planar and conical type of connection in an experiment under conditions of cyclic loads simulating functional loads in the oral cavity. Methods. The strength characteristics of the cement-screw connection (CSC) of multiunit abutments to dental implants made of Ti-6Al-4V alloy with a diameter of 3.75 mm and a length of 11.5 mm with a conical and planar type of connection were evaluated. A total of 48 dental implants were included in the experiment – 24 with a planar and 24 with a conical type of connection. In turn, every 24 implants were divided into six groups depending on the experimental conditions: three groups with a loading angle of 22.5° and a force of 100 N with a number of loading cycles of 100 000, 150 000 and 200 000; three groups at loading angle of 45° and impact force of 100 N with number of loading cycles of 100 000, 150 000 and 200 000. Results. In comparative analysis of the strength of experimental samples under maximum load conditions (loading angle of 45° and 200,000 loading cycles) in the 2nd position of the implant, as the weakest element of the entire structure, it was revealed that with the conical type, the depth of the CSC decreases by 19 %, and the degree of screw clamping – by 73 % from the initial level to the load, while with the planar type, similar parameters decrease by 33 % and 80 %, respectively. Conclusion. It has been established that the conical type of connection is more reliable than the planar type, its use allows you to increase the resistance to loads, since the accumulation of fatigue of orthopedic structures with a conical multi-unit connection increases in 1.2 times, with a planar multi-unit connection – in 1.5 times. compound simulating the projection of the 2nd premolar) by 24 % compared to the planar type of compound.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究牙科植入物连接强度，不涉及增材制造，与方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing process is involved; the Ti-6Al-4V implants are conventionally manufactured and the study focuses on dental implant connections rather than AM mechanical or fatigue performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析牙科植入物水泥-螺钉固定强度特性
summary_zh.method: 对平面和锥形连接类型的Ti-6Al-4V植入物进行循环加载实验
summary_zh.result: 锥形连接比平面连接更可靠，疲劳积累增加1.2倍 vs 1.5倍
summary_zh.validation: 实验循环加载测试，共48个植入物

summary_en.motivation: To analyze the strength characteristics of cement-screw fixation of multi-unit abutments to dental implants under cyclic loads.
summary_en.method: Cyclic loading experiments were conducted on Ti-6Al-4V dental implants with flat and conical connections at two angles and varying cycle counts.
summary_en.result: Conical connection showed 19% less depth reduction and 73% vs 80% screw clamping loss compared to flat connection under maximum load.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing with 48 implants under cyclic loading conditions simulating oral function.
